role: CANON A.5 narrow read interface from Layer 2 (Perception) into Layer 3 (Knowledge Graph) — answers: has the system seen this object before?
detail: Implements find_matching_object() async function that matches a new Observation against known Instance nodes in the knowledge graph. Matching strategy: (1) embedding-based cosine similarity (threshold 0.7) filtered to active nodes (valid_to=None), (2) label_raw property exact match on active Instance nodes, (3) preference order: embedding match > label match; embedding confidence carried as-is (0.7-1.0), label-only match fixed at 0.5, no match 0.0. Returns PersistenceResult with matched flag, candidate_node_id, confidence score, match_type ('embedding'/'label'/'none'), and alternatives list for secondary embedding hits. Enforces active-node filtering: superseded nodes (valid_to not None) are excluded from all results.
gotchas: Empty alternatives list for label and no-match cases; embedding match is guaranteed sorted by descending score from find_similar_nodes; label matching returns first match only (no secondary candidates collected); no explicit error handling — assumes persistence backend never fails
